  L(\theta) = \sum_i \ell_i(\theta) \label{eq:one}

\[ a = b \]

  y &= 2
\end{align}

  \item[(b)] Second, with

    \item a nested one;
    \item and another.
  \end{enumerate}
\end{itemize}
